ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: Music of Luciano Berio Luciano Berio?s music and ideas represent seminal contributions to 20th & early 21st century art. His works have broken new ground with respect to the relationship of words and music, musical dramaturgy, virtuosity, orchestration, and notation ? all produced through his unique philosophical and aesthetic lens. This seminar offers an opportunity to take an in-depth look at this remarkable body of work.
